documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue of INR 716.38 crores, representing a 144.69% year-on-year growth driven by volume expansion, new design rollouts, and customer acquisition. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 71.45 crores with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%, aided by inventory valuation gains, while normalized EBITDA is expected around 7.5% to 8%. Management maintained its full-year guidance for 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth, alongside a top-line target of INR 3,500 crores. The company commenced operations at its new Marol manufacturing facility and is progressing with the upcoming Jaipur facility and a rights issue of up to INR 100 crores to support future growth. Shanti Gold International Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, highlighting robust financial and operational performance with a significant year-on-year increase in revenue, EBITDA, and net profit.

guidance.claim: Management expects sustainable EBITDA margin to be around 7.5% to 8% for the year.
guidance.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

guidance.claim: Management expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the profit after tax margin is sustainable at around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

guidance.claim: Management expects next year's turnover to be around INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores with 35% to 40% growth.
guidance.quote: So next year like around we expecting a turnover of around INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores and with 35% to 40% growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for organized jewellery remains constructive, supported by wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and preference for organized retail.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive. India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains very bullish on the long-term fundamentals of gold despite near-term short-term jitters.
demand_outlook.quote: So the long-term, our vision towards the gold is very, very bullish. The long-term fundamentals remain very strong. So we are hopeful that the gold will, maybe there could be a short-term jitters in the near-term, but going forward in the long-term, we expect a good rally in the gold market, and we remain very bullish on that because the fundamentals remain very strong for the gold.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer traction and demand visibility remain strong across the business.
demand_outlook.quote: We remain encouraged by the customer traction and demand visibility across our business with a stronger manufacturing base, expanding customer relationships, and a differentiated product portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that growing disposable income drives gold as a status symbol and investment.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing disposable income drives gold as status symbol & investment

demand_outlook.claim: The company identified seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali, and harvest festivals as key demand drivers.
demand_outlook.quote: Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that the company continues to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company continues to receive sustained inquiries and repeat purchases from its customers.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouragingly, we continue to receive sustained inquiries and repeat purchases from our customers, which provide us with confidence and visibility regarding future business momentum.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations have successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen the company's manufacturing footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, the upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen our manufacturing footprint and support our ability to address the growing demand across markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur facility is allotted a capex of INR 47 crores and is expected to be operational around mid-November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the new Marol factory is almost ready and should start in a month or so.
capex_expansion.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 9.97% and PAT margin stood at 7.05%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR71.45 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%. The profit after tax stood at INR50.48 crores compared to INR34.36 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Roughly 2% to 2.5% of the EBITDA margin in Q1 comprised unrealized inventory gains realized from finished goods due to a change in the inventory valuation method from FIFO to WAC.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a gross margin of 10.9% for Q1 FY27.
The EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 10.0%.
The PAT margin for Q1 FY27 was reported at 7.1%.
EBITDA margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 10.17% compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 7.88% as against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for the quarter stood at 7.88% as against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity utilization of the existing Mumbai facility is currently at 75%.
The total installed capacity on completion is stated to be 7,900 kg per annum.
Once operational, the capacity additions will take total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the present capacity utilization is around 65%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares aggregating up to INR 100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management plans to keep the debt-to-equity ratio below 1x while managing incremental working capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: So certainly, our working capital needs will be higher in the coming years and all. And plus at the same time, we will do a prudent finance management, having a better matrix of debt-equity so that it doesn't go more than one at this stage.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the debt-equity ratio is at 0.36.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, and as far as the value again, if you see the metrics also, my debt-equity is at 0.36.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company should be comfortable going up to a 1:1 debt-to-equity ratio to fuel future growth expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: To answer your question, maximum at this point if I say, we should be comfortable at going at 1:1. That's what we are aiming for now to fuel the future growth expansion.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended to June '26 due to geopolitical issues and wars.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to achieve 30% to 40% volume growth and 50% to 60% value growth for the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year. So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur facility is expected to be operational around mid-November or December.
management_commitments.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to scale export share from 10% to 20% or more.
management_commitments.quote: So I told you like this year will be like from 5% to we are going to go up to 10% or maybe more. Sorry, from 10% to 20%.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Jaipur factory should start by around September, October.
management_commitments.quote: and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
